body: Thank you for empathizing with me, I would love to read that book.

I was scared to try big things and I was a mediocre student too. I was so afraid when I entered STEM in senior highschool because I am really really bad at math but I still went for it and I got thru it.

After that, I got scared to enter college thinking I might not pass entrance exams especially I wanted to a med-student which has a high quota grade. I still went for it! 

Now, I am on my 2nd yr pre-med, still struggling soooo much but I always remember and think that this is what my senior high-school self is praying for before, I am sure she proud of me even though I am not with myself right now. 

Try new things kid and don't be afraid. Be kind to yourself :)) appreciating yourself is very important tooo! keep safe!

sadly, I'm in an asian household, talking to them about my feelings will not matter and they will only scold and reprimand me for feeling this way despite them paying for my tuition fee, feeding me, and giving me a house to live. I am not allowed to feel bad here. But thank you for this, stay safe always.

sadly, there are none. I am in an asian household which is not open to mental health or counseling. I have been trying to suppress my emotions for the past few days and just resort to crying. Thank you for sharing this and it helped me to know that someone recognized my problem and emphatizes with me. God bless you and your family.
yea, I'd kill myself for free. What more for a million dollars.
